SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3, mini browser build, Apache-2.0.
Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.mini.min.js
Official installation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/
Vendored for private-browser XLSX import/export. No CDN requests or workbook data leave the authenticated application. Only XLSX is accepted by the sampling importer; formulas are not executed or used as observations.
